name: Starship V3 Propellant Tank
description: Flight 12 V3 common-bulkhead tank model. The 1,400 t loading and component dry mass are simulator estimates, not SpaceX acceptance data. axial_drag_coefficient 0.30 is a calibrated estimate for a bare 9 m cylindrical barrel (skin friction plus a modest base contribution); it is only consulted when this section is the vessel root or through the length-weighted fallback in PartGraph.AxialDragCoefficient. Body-flap planforms (hinge station, length, span) are image-derived estimates from Flight 7 proportions; deflection range and servo rate are simulator estimates. Main tanks exclude the header loads (23.5 t LOX in the nose, 6.5 t CH4 header here), so the stage total is unchanged.
